texts.preamble: Mohmmad Anwar Khan And Another vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 9 May, 2024 -1- 914-Aba.651.2024 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad 914 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 651 Of 2024 Mohmmad Anwar Khan And Another Versus The State Of Maharashtra And Another ... Advocate for Applicants : Mr. Suniket Kulkarni & Ms. Rutuja L. Jakhade App for Respondent - State : Mr. D. R. Karde ... Coram : Abhay S. Waghwase, J. Dated : 9th May, 2024 Per Court : 1. Heard. 2.
texts.facts: Learned Counsel for the applicants pointed out that applicants are owners of vehicles, which were allegedly intercepted by complainant i.e. Food Safety Officer, Dhule. That there are allegations that banned tobacco products were transported. Learned Counsel pointed out that infact applicants are owners of the Trucks and they have nothing to do with alleged contraband. That drivers merely provided their names as owners. There are allegations that banned tobacco products were being transported and were intercepted while vehicles were coming from Gujarat State carrying tobacco products worth lakhs of Rupees. Flying squad claims that interception and seizure was effected near Sai Hotel, Shirpur. On enquiry with Drivers and Cleaners, details of the ownership of the vehicles were revealed i.e. of present applicants. Police Papers show that after registration of crime, investigating machinery has seized the vehicles and alleged contraband by drawing panchanama. Spot panchanama and seizure panchanama are also shown to be drawn on 04-02-2024 and samples are also shown to be despatched to the Laboratory for analysis. Statements of participants of raiding party are also recorded.
texts.arguments: That there is nothing beyond such statements of Drivers to connect present applicants with the alleged seizure. Learned Counsel pointed out that already goods have been seized alongwith vehicles. Nothing fresh is to be recovered or discovered. That applicants are ready to co-operate with investigating machinery and hence, prayers for grant of anticipatory bail. 3. Learned APP, who placed documents on record, pointed out that applicants are owners of the vehicles. That there are {3} ABA 651 OF 2024 Registration Certificate particulars of ownership. That at their behest, goods were transported to unknown destination. 5. The principal ground for opposing the instant anticipatory bail {4} ABA 651 OF 2024 application is that investigation is incomplete and according to learned APP, destination of the goods to be taken to and further investigation as to exactly from where products were manufactured and transferred is yet to be revealed and moreover, contraband is found in the vehicles owned by applicants and therefore, their custodial interrogation is necessary. Learned APP pointed out that huge quantity of contraband has been seized. 6. Admittedly, contraband and vehicles are already seized by the Police.
texts.respondent_arguments: That there is nothing beyond such statements of Drivers to connect present applicants with the alleged seizure. Learned Counsel pointed out that already goods have been seized alongwith vehicles. Nothing fresh is to be recovered or discovered. That applicants are ready to co-operate with investigating machinery and hence, prayers for grant of anticipatory bail. 3. Learned APP, who placed documents on record, pointed out that applicants are owners of the vehicles. That there are {3} ABA 651 OF 2024 Registration Certificate particulars of ownership. That at their behest, goods were transported to unknown destination. 5. The principal ground for opposing the instant anticipatory bail {4} ABA 651 OF 2024 application is that investigation is incomplete and according to learned APP, destination of the goods to be taken to and further investigation as to exactly from where products were manufactured and transferred is yet to be revealed and moreover, contraband is found in the vehicles owned by applicants and therefore, their custodial interrogation is necessary. Learned APP pointed out that huge quantity of contraband has been seized. 6. Admittedly, contraband and vehicles are already seized by the Police.
